The bedtime routine

Simple Enough for the
Hardest Nights

Works for exhausted parents — not in spite of them. If you can do three things, you can do this.

Step 1
Apply

Place on clean dry skin — upper arm, shoulder, or back. Stays secure all night through tossing and turning.

Step 2
Peel

Peel one patch from the backing about 30 minutes before bed. Make it part of the wind-down ritual — kids love the routine.

Step 3
Sleep

The patch works while they sleep — slowly and steadily for up to 8 hours. Peel off in the morning. No residue, no irritation.
